name: 広告とサービス情報を添える施設検索カード
prompt:
Create one vertically stacked Japanese sponsored-place result card on a clean white canvas, closely matching the portrait crop proportions and hierarchy in the supplied references.

Reference priority:
1) The original sponsored-result crop controls card geometry, image positions and sizes, spacing, dividers, typography hierarchy, rating row, metadata, quote and action placement.
2) The two square source-photo crops are protected original photographs. Preserve each photograph and visible crop faithfully: photo 1 is a halal grocery shop refrigerator aisle with blue product signs and stacked tubs; photo 2 is raw meat on dark cutting boards over a light wood table. Do not replace, redraw, add details, recolor, zoom or filter either photograph. Keep photo 1 on the left and photo 2 on the right.
3) The Japanese preview controls exact Japanese copy, green accent and adapted card styling. Use its copy exactly.

Include a header “スポンサーの検索結果” with a small outlined question-mark information icon at the right. Place the two protected square photos side by side beneath it, with softly rounded corners and a narrow gap. Below them include the title “地域のお肉と食材のお店”. Add four full green square star tiles and one neutral-gray star tile, then “4.2 (2千件)”. Add the location line “渋谷区・¥¥” with a location pin, and the green availability text “営業中・19:00まで”. Add the takeout/service line “持ち帰り可能” with a simple outlined shopping bag icon. Add the exact review “「初めての訪問でした。食材の種類が豊富で、また立ち寄りたいと思いました」” and the green link “続きを読む”. At the bottom, place outlined pill tags “精肉店” and “食材” on the left and one solid green primary button “注文する” on the right.

Use the preview's white background, near-black title, muted gray supporting text, pale neutral borders, restrained #2D8F5E green, clean Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif and compact mobile spacing. Keep the card as one coherent vertical component with source-aligned hierarchy and clean baselines.

Do not add a phone frame, status bar, bottom navigation, extra listings, extra tags, invented words, extra icons, decorative background or watermark. Preserve the two supplied photos in their original order, subject, color, crop and visible details.
reviewNotes: 保護写真の細部が再生成され要修正
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
